text:
Priya - CS: Heads-up: AtlasWave reserved bring-up scheduled Mon 09:00 PT. Need final quota + autoscale + smoke/stress plan. Who's free for coordination today?

Leo - SRE: I can take autoscale knobs. Are we expecting steady QPS number?

Priya - CS: They committed to Reserved (vCPU/GPU pool). Target steady ~500 RPS, short bursts to 1100 for up to 20m.

Sam - Platform: Proposed test flow: 1) canary 10% for 15m, 2) ramp to 100% over 30m, 3) spike to 1100 for 15m, 4) cool down. Use rolling deployment with fallback to model-v1-compact on latency >1.5s.

Rina - Solutions: They have heavy repeated prompts; recommend pre-warm prefix cache and include 25 canonical prompts for regression checks. I'll prepare those.

Leo - SRE: Autoscale config suggestion: target_cpu_util=60%, cooldown=120s, max_replicas=10, min_replicas=3. Quota burst token=1250 to avoid transient throttles. Add alert: "atlaswave.errors > 0.5% for 10m" to paging.

Priya - CS: Can we run the loadtest Sat 02:00 PT? Need artifact for customer playbook.

Sam - Platform: I will run it in the staging cluster. Script: `./scripts/stress --env staging --target 500 --ramp 30m --hold 15m --spike 1100 --spike-duration 15m` Will push metrics to s3 and post link.

ci-bot: loadtest/atlaswave-stress-174222 started (job id: lt-174222) :rocket:

Leo - SRE: Watch for OOMs on host-5, kvcache hit rate, and any compaction GC events. If p99 > 1.5s during spike, we should route spike traffic to compact model.

Rina - Solutions: I'll build the enablement doc (on-call play, expected behaviors, escalation matrix) and upload prompts.

ci-bot: loadtest/atlaswave-stress-174222 finished. Results: s3://redwood-loadtests/atlaswave/174222/results.json

Sam - Platform: Quick summary: steady window p95=380ms p99=900ms errors=0.09% GPUutil=68% KVhit=81%. Spike window p99=1.62s errors=0.6%.

Leo - SRE: Spike errors slightly above our 0.5% SLA threshold. Recommendation: during go-live route spike-> model-v1-compact and add +2 replicas for first 2 hours.

Priya - CS: I'll set customer expectations and include the SLA trigger in the runbook. Action items: Sam post full metrics + graphs; Leo apply autoscale changes tomorrow; Rina upload runbook + prompts. Follow-up sync Mon 08:30 PT.

Rina - Solutions: Runbook link posted to drive in folder "AtlasWave_Onboard" and shared to customer.

Priya - CS: Thanks all. If anything unexpected comes up ping me here. :thumbsup:
